Quips have been added to the game!  These are a new sound emote that will use VXQ slots 1, 2, 3 or 4 on PC, the X>LB slot for Xbox, or the Square>R1 slot for PlayStation.
Quips are short sounds that are played in character proximity and can be heard by both teams.
Quips are subject to spam flood protection!

You can now save builds for your favorite gods, and share them with the community!
This is the first version of this feature; we will continue to iterate on it over upcoming patches.
Autobuild and autolevel integration with this feature will be coming in a future update.
Builds can be created from the main menu, by clicking on Gods, choosing a God, then clicking God Builder
Make your own build by going to the My Builds tab, then clicking Create Build.
First, name your build, add a description, set which mode and roles it’s for, and whether or not it uses an Aspect.
Then set your Final Build, Starting Items, and the Ability levelling order
You can add up to three additional sections of items with names, short, and long descriptions to explain alternate builds, situational items, or whatever you have in mind.
See Community Builds by clicking the Community Builds tab. You can Pin or Favorite builds.
In-match, access God Builds via the Item Store
Open the Store, then click on God Builder
Find your favorite build, and click Pin to Store
Your chosen build with all information will replace the Recommended tab, and indicators will flash over recommended Abilities to level.
NEW - Skin Special Emotes aka VXGs
Special Emote functionality has been added to SMITE 2! Players can use these emotes for Skins that have them by inputting the “Special Emote 2” VGS Command.
Basscannon Neith and Heaven’s Rave Zeus have the same tech for their Special Emotes from SMITE 1 that will sync the music they play if both skins use their emotes in the same area in match.
“Firebrands offer a way for junglers, solo laners, and mid laners a way to gain incremental power. They spawn in pairs and will enrage when one of them is slain!”
Spawns in the Fire Giant pit at 3 minutes
There are two total within the pit
When slain, drops two Fire Giant embers
Grants the same bonuses as the Fire Giant embers that naturally spawn in the pit
When one of the Firebrands dies, the other enrages!
The enraged Firebrand gains increased health, attack speed, and power
When the Fire Giant spawns, the Firebrands are removed from the pit and will no longer spawn in the match

“SMITE 1 players will recognize how this feature works. For new players joining us in SMITE 2, here’s a breakdown of how the new timers work:”
Jungle timers will now have two states:
If an enemy did not witness a camp being cleared, they will have no knowledge of when a camp will spawn
This means that the enemy will see an empty camp on the minimap with no respawn timer
If an enemy did witness a camp being cleared, they will see the respawn timer for that camp as normal
This means that the enemy is fully aware of when a camp will respawn

If your team is behind in Team Gold on the scoreboard, all Structures and Neutral Bosses (Tower, Phoenix, FG, GF, Naga, Pyro) will award your team bonus Gold (up to +65% of the objective's value.)
How much bonus Gold your team gets depends on how far behind your team is, up to a maximum of 8000 Gold behind.
This mapping is exponential, so the bonus gold while only slightly behind is meagre, and while moderately behind is still fairly small.
